summary_en: For insurance brokers and corporate policyholders in Canada, at the point where legal expense
  coverage is needed, a companion AI platform takes part in underwriting or claims for the legal expense
  insurance, delivering a legal expense insurance policy; what material the AI ingests and what it does
  are not stated publicly, nor is the human confirmation step.
inspiration_en: The trend is brokers selling their own insurance products bundled with AI processing instead
  of only distributing others' products, pushing down marginal underwriting and claims cost. A wedge is
  an underwriting and claims layer for long-tail lines such as legal expense and liability at small and
  mid-size insurers, priced per policy or per claim, with the moat in licenses and claims data rather
  than models.
